name: Microscope X/Y calibration (lattice)
description: New X/Y piezo calibration constants from lattice images of a known crystal (KBr, NaCl, HOPG …), fitted over every open scan; before → after lattice figure and statistics.

material.label: Reference crystal
material.default: KBr(001) — a = 6.65 Å, γ = 90°, diagonal 4.7 Å (Hinaut 2012)
choices: KBr(001) — a = 6.65 Å, γ = 90°, diagonal 4.7 Å (Hinaut 2012)
material.description: Fills a, b, γ and the diagonal (source shown in the log). Choose “Custom” to use the four values below.

a_angstrom.label: a (Å) — with Custom
a_angstrom.description: Lattice constant a. KBr: 6.65 Å (conventional cell); the 4.7 Å cell seen in the image is recognised automatically.

b_angstrom.label: b (Å) — with Custom, 0 = same as a

gamma_deg.label: γ (°) — with Custom, 0 = unknown
gamma_deg.description: Angle between a and b (90° square/rectangular, 120° hexagonal). Gives the two diagonals, which make X and Y separable even for a lattice at 45°.

diagonal_angstrom.label: Diagonal (Å) — with Custom, 0 = none
diagonal_angstrom.description: Full diagonal |a ± b| or half diagonal (KBr: 4.7 Å = distance between neighbouring ions of the same species). Checked against a, b, γ.

auto_match_cell.label: Recognise conventional vs primitive cell
auto_match_cell.description: If the detected lattice matches a/√2 or a·√2 (square), a·√3 or a/√3 (hexagonal) of the value entered — e.g. KBr a0 = 6.60 Å entered while the image shows the 4.67 Å surface cell — use that exact description and say so in the log.

previous_cx_nm_per_v.label: Previous calibration X (nm/V) — 0 = from file
previous_cx_nm_per_v.description: Used when the file has no piezo calibration (or with the override below). Leave 0 and 0 to get correction factors only.

override_metadata.label: Use these previous values instead of the files'

fit_axis_skew.label: Also fit X/Y axis non-orthogonality
fit_axis_skew.description: Adds a third parameter (angle between the piezo axes ≠ 90°). Needs vectors in ≥ 3 independent directions (e.g. scans at 0° and 90° with a rotated lattice).

drift_mode.label: Thermal drift
drift_mode.description: Header: the drift compensation written in each file (Nanonis Piezo Configuration › Drift X/Y, on/off) is taken into account. Fit: one drift velocity for the session is fitted with the calibration — needs up and down scans, 0°/90° scans or different speeds. Up/down pairs give an independent check.

max_deviation_percent.label: Reject lattices off by more than (%)
max_deviation_percent.description: A detected cell this far from the reference is another lattice, a superstructure or an FFT harmonic and is not used.
